name: Cursor
description: OpenClaw Cursor agent harness and model provider plugin backed by @cursor/sdk.

runtime.label: Cursor Runtime
runtime.help: Use a local Cursor agent against the workspace, or a Cursor-hosted cloud agent.

apiKeyEnv.label: API Key Env Var
apiKeyEnv.help: Environment variable that holds the Cursor API key (user or service-account key).

discovery.label: Model Discovery
discovery.help: Live model catalog discovery via Cursor.models.list().

local.sandboxEnabled.label: Sandbox
local.sandboxEnabled.help: Enable Cursor local sandboxOptions for tool execution.

local.autoReview.label: Auto-review
local.autoReview.help: Enable Cursor Auto-review classifier for local tool calls when the backend supports it.

local.useHttp1ForAgent.label: HTTP/1.1 for Agent
local.useHttp1ForAgent.help: Force HTTP/1.1 + SSE instead of HTTP/2. Enable behind HTTP proxies that break HTTP/2 streaming (common with corporate or country egress proxies).

local.backgroundJobs.label: Background Jobs
local.backgroundJobs.help: Expose openclaw_background_job custom tool for non-blocking Cursor work on local runtime.

local.backgroundJobs.enabled.label: Background Jobs Enabled
local.backgroundJobs.enabled.help: When true, the Cursor agent can spawn background jobs via openclaw_background_job.

local.backgroundJobs.maxConcurrent.label: Max Concurrent Background Jobs
local.backgroundJobs.maxConcurrent.help: Maximum number of background Cursor agents running at once.

local.backgroundJobs.notifyOnComplete.label: Notify On Complete
local.backgroundJobs.notifyOnComplete.help: Send a channel message when a background job finishes (requires messaging context from the spawn turn).

local.backgroundJobs.persistJobs.label: Persist Job Registry
local.backgroundJobs.persistJobs.help: Write background job status to the OpenClaw state dir (survives plugin reload; not active runs).

cursorDynamicToolsExclude.label: Excluded OpenClaw Tools
cursorDynamicToolsExclude.help: OpenClaw tool names that should not be bridged into Cursor customTools.
